title: Windows store consolidation quarantine fix
intent: Verification and PR handoff for Issue #4296
progress_summary: Root-caused the os error 5 quarantine failure: apply_store_consolidation held its own works.lock handle inside the store it then renamed, which Windows refuses. Split WorkStoreLeases into resident/source leases and release the source leases before the move on Windows; mapped a blocked move to a retryable WriterBusy refusal instead of CorruptInput + raw os error 5. Added a Windows regression test and fixed the CLI test diagnostic that hid the refusal payload on stdout.
